scope: Offline phase-native feature replay only. The repair preserves the frozen 15-minute source interval and never touches live state, exchange I/O, targets, predictions, MC1, admission, or portfolio rules.

finding.symptom: Three independent :15/:30/:45 panel workers reproducibly blocked inside individual legacy Arrow scans, first raw 15-minute and then a funding sidecar.
finding.evidence: A macOS sample of PID 53065 showed pyarrow.dataset.ParquetFileFragment.ReadPhysicalSchemaImpl blocked in a kernel read on JUP. A bounded 170-symbol filtered-read audit subsequently identified WLD as a timed-out raw scan with a healthy shared 15-minute mirror. After raw-source repair, all phases reached 150/170 and a sample of PID 57298 showed the same blocked Arrow stack on ETH funding sidecar.

repair.behavior: The shared causal panel loader checks a versioned raw-source quarantine before opening a raw shard. Quarantined raw JUP/WLD use the existing same-interval shared 15-minute mirror; no hourly or minute fallback is introduced. Quarantined funding sidecars remain missing after the official archive ends rather than being imputed.
repair.lineage: The exact raw and sidecar quarantine receipts are embedded in each newly written phase panel state and state manifest.

commands: python3 - <<'PY' ... _read_downloaded_15m_hourly for JUP/USD:USD and WLD/USD:USD at phase 15 ... PY
validation_evidence.result: The filtered-read audit found one unhealthy raw source without a mirror gap (WLD); the explicit JUP diagnostic remains quarantined. Both JUP and WLD produced 72 complete phase-15 shared-mirror hourly rows for 2026-07-12 through 2026-07-15. The ETH funding guard completed a four-hour causal panel call with no unavailable funding values imputed. Syntax, JSON, and whitespace checks passed.
